verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents bring-your-own model backends: you pick from many LLM providers, authenticate, and set the default model. Community reports confirm it was used with Claude subscriptions via `claude -p` and with Google AI subscriptions, though Anthropic and Google have since restricted subscription use. Nothing in the pack shows any token-usage or cost reporting, whether per model or per conversation. missing for 10: token usage tracking, cost reporting per model, cost/usage per conversation, independent hands-on corroboration of the provider setup.
